rankGateProvenance: Draft gameplay gates: dock rank 4 from the master prompt; subway rank 1 adds no extra geography rank requirement. Facility unlocks may impose a higher rank independently. GDD approval pending.

locations.name: Tokyo
locations.networkNotes: Tokyo Metro is an operating subway. Eligibility does not imply that every fictional parcel has a station connection.

sources.title: Route and station information
sources.evidence: Operator publishes the operating subway map, line information, stations, and transfer search.

locations.name: Osaka
locations.networkNotes: Osaka Metro subway lines qualify; New Tram alone would not establish subway eligibility.

sources.title: Subway route map
sources.evidence: Operator identifies the map and current service status as subway service.

locations.name: Seoul
locations.networkNotes: Operating metropolitan subway qualifies. City transport authority corroboration used because the operator English page could not be fetched.

sources.publisher: Seoul Transport Operation and Information Service
sources.title: Seoul subway information
sources.evidence: City transport service describes operating subway lines and station guidance.

sources.title: Public transportation
sources.evidence: Current official passenger guide explains use of subway stations, tickets and Seoul Subway application.

locations.name: Dubai
locations.networkNotes: Red and Green lines qualify through operating underground infrastructure. Planned Blue Line infrastructure is not the basis for eligibility.

sources.title: Metro and tram stations map
sources.evidence: Operating Red and Green metro routes include Union and BurJuman.

sources.title: Masar magazine, issue 1
sources.evidence: Historical infrastructure description identifies Union Square as an underground transfer station; paired with current operating route evidence.

locations.name: Abu Dhabi
locations.networkNotes: No qualifying operating subway was established from the checked official sources. ART is explicitly rail-less buses. Future or planned metro proposals do not qualify; unverified eligibility remains disabled.

sources.title: Automated Rapid Transit project
sources.evidence: Authority describes ART as electric public buses on a rail-less system, not a subway.

sources.title: Public transport services
sources.evidence: Current authority service listing did not establish an operating underground railway. Absence from this page is not treated as conclusive proof of no network.

locations.name: New York
locations.networkNotes: Operating New York City Subway qualifies; above-ground sections do not exclude its subway infrastructure.

sources.title: New York City Subway map
sources.evidence: MTA publishes the current city subway diagram and service lines.

locations.name: Shanghai
locations.networkNotes: Operating Shanghai Metro underground lines qualify. Official city evidence corroborates the operator; the operator English website timed out.

sources.title: Shanghai Metro extends reach beyond 900 km
sources.evidence: Official city report of operating metro extension includes underground stations and distinguishes a station not yet opened.

sources.title: How to take metro in Shanghai
sources.evidence: Current official passenger guide describes metro ticketing and journeys.

locations.name: Hong Kong
locations.networkNotes: MTR's operating subway infrastructure qualifies; this is not a claim that every MTR mode or station is underground.

sources.title: System map and station layouts
sources.evidence: Operator lists operating urban lines and their station layouts, including Central, Admiralty and Tsim Sha Tsui.

sources.title: Travel tips during typhoons
sources.evidence: Operator explicitly distinguishes underground railway services from open sections.

locations.name: Beijing
locations.networkNotes: Operating Beijing Subway qualifies. Fictional site availability remains a separate gate.

sources.title: Subway map and first/last trains
sources.evidence: Operator publishes subway map and operating first/last train information.

locations.name: Las Vegas
locations.geographicScope: Las Vegas metropolitan area, Nevada, United States
locations.networkNotes: The checked passenger systems do not qualify: elevated Monorail is not a subway and Vegas Loop moves road vehicles in tunnels, not subway trains.

sources.title: Official route map
sources.evidence: Operator describes an elevated monorail route.

sources.title: Loop
sources.evidence: Operator describes passengers transported by Tesla vehicles in tunnels. Underground road transport does not establish a subway railway.

locations.name: San Francisco
locations.networkNotes: BART and Muni have operating underground infrastructure; mixed surface and elevated sections do not disqualify the network.

sources.title: BART Wireless Technology Program
sources.evidence: BART describes completed cellular coverage in SFMTA tunnels and underground stations including Central Subway.

sources.title: Civic Center / UN Plaza station
sources.evidence: Operator lists current San Francisco train services and station departures.

locations.name: Chicago
locations.networkNotes: CTA qualifies through actual Red and Blue Line subway sections even though the network is called the L.

sources.title: L service overview
sources.evidence: Operator identifies Red and Blue Line service via downtown subway.

sources.title: Lake Red Line station
sources.evidence: Operator explicitly categorizes the operating Lake station as Subway and gives service arrivals.

locations.name: Hawaii
locations.geographicScope: Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii, United States (fictional parcels)
locations.networkNotes: Hawaii is the requested menu label; these parcels are in Honolulu on Oahu. Skyline's elevated and short at-grade alignment has no subway infrastructure. Hawaii-only docks are optional on a compatible waterfront parcel.

sources.title: Skyline
sources.evidence: Operating Skyline passenger information and schedules.

sources.title: The project
sources.evidence: Authority describes an elevated alignment except for a short at-grade section; this does not qualify as subway infrastructure.

sources.title: Construction overview
sources.evidence: Authority separates currently operating segments from future construction. Planned service is not counted.
